title: Speaking — Reusing belongings
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on reusing belongings.

questions: When do you normally walk rather than take transport?
Which local route do you enjoy walking along?
Do you usually walk alone or with someone?
What would encourage you to walk more where you live?
Which possessions do you try to keep for a long time?
Do you use anything someone else owned before you?

part2.topic: Describe an object you found a new use for.
points: what you use it for now
part2.closing: and explain what made the new use practical.

questions: What could councils do to make reuse easier than throwing things away?
When is buying a durable new product more practical than repairing an old one?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to reusing belongings?
